steps.sql: WITH n AS (SELECT TOP (65536) CONVERT(int,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))-1) AS u FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) SELECT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(varchar(max),CONVERT(varbinary(1),CONVERT(varchar(1),NCHAR(u) COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS)),2),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u) AS encoded FROM n;

WITH n AS (SELECT TOP (65536) CONVERT(int,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))-1) AS u FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) SELECT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(varchar(max),CONVERT(varbinary(2),CONVERT(nvarchar(1),CONVERT(varchar(1),CONVERT(binary(1),u)))),2),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u) AS decoded FROM n WHERE u<256;
